notes: A song that finishes with nothing after it is now silence, and the phone is told so. The last second of a song used to leave the now-playing card frozen at its end with a pause button - SideCut claiming it was still playing - because a song that reaches its end does not send the pause that normally updates the card.

And that frozen ending could bring the same song back by itself. The background keep-alive cannot tell a song that finished from one the phone paused, so half a minute later it started the finished file again from the beginning, silently, with nothing open and nobody asking for it.

Both are one door now: when an advance has nothing to start - the next song is gone from the library, its audio file is missing, or there is nothing after it - both players are stopped, the card says paused, the phone is allowed to sleep, and nothing tries to revive a player that has nothing to play.
A queue that keeps working is not touched: a song that did start is playing on its own element, so it is never mistaken for the one that ended.
